title: AuthConfiguration
description: Server branding and behaviour for the sign-in and account creation screens

theme.description:
Appearance of everything outside the sign-in container. `custom` whenever a login background image has been uploaded, `default` otherwise

* `default` - Default
* `custom` - Customizable

background_image_url.description: Relative URL of the login background image, or `null` when none has been uploaded

show_kobotoolbox_logo.description: Whether to display the KoboToolbox logo outside the container

server_tag.description:
Server name tag shown at the top of the container, or `null` on servers that have none. Takes precedence over `logo_url`

* `global` - Global
* `eu` - EU

logo_url.description: Relative URL of the logo shown at the top of the container when `server_tag` is `null`, or `null` when none has been uploaded

supporting_image_url.description: Relative URL of the image displayed alongside the account creation form, or `null` when none has been uploaded

supporting_text.description: Rendered HTML displayed alongside the account creation form, localized for the request language. Empty when unset
